traditional: Love, money, and pleasure combined with action and heat. One benefic, one malefic: the benefic tempers the malefic.

modern.blend: Attraction meets drive. Desire, and the channeling of energy into pleasure, art, or pursuit. The conjunction can either fuse charm and drive or have the two cancel out.
modern.harmonious: Popularity and energy that flows easily into creative or romantic pursuits.
modern.hard: Bad timing in romance, indecision, and friction between wanting and acting.
modern.business: Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.

provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
